name: EHR Consultants
description: The most comprehensive directory of CPHIMS- and CHDA-credentialed EHR consultants, implementation specialists, and health IT advisors serving medical practices and clinics across the United States.
certifications: CPHIMS (Certified Professional in Health Informatics and Information Management)
CAHIMS (Certified Associate in Health Informatics and Information Management)
cityPagePromptContext:
EHR consultants help medical practices and clinics select, implement, and optimize electronic health record systems.
Credentialed professionals (CPHIMS, CHDA, RHIA) guide practices through vendor selection, workflow redesign, data migration, staff training, and post-go-live optimization. Medical groups hire them when adopting a new EHR, switching from a legacy platform, or struggling with billing and documentation inefficiencies. Consultants assess practice needs, negotiate with vendors, oversee implementation timelines, and ensure the system supports MIPS, interoperability, and HIPAA compliance requirements.
buyerSearchContext: when selecting or switching EHR platforms, preparing for MIPS/MACRA reporting, or optimizing clinical workflows after a go-live

editorialAuthor.name: Nick Palmer
editorialAuthor.title: Founder & Lead Researcher
editorialAuthor.bio: Nick built this directory to help medical groups find credentialed EHR consultants without wading through vendors who mostly want to sell software subscriptions — a conflict of interest he ran into when trying to help a family member’s practice navigate a painful EMR migration.

schema.label: EHR Platform Certifications
schema.scrape_hint: Scan certifications section, team bios, or vendor badge logos for Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, or Meditech credentials; match exact platform names and certification tiers.

schema.label: Years of Experience
schema.scrape_hint: Extract from 'About Us', team bios, or '15+ years in health IT' statements; calculate from founding year if business start date is provided.

schema.label: Professional Certifications
schema.scrape_hint: Scan credentials sections, team pages, or digital badges for HIMSS, AHIMA, and PMI certifications; match exact acronyms and full credential names.

schema.label: Vendor-Agnostic (No Software Ties)
schema.scrape_hint: Look for statements like 'we are not affiliated with any EHR vendor', 'independent consulting', 'unbiased platform selection', or absence of reseller or referral arrangements in services or about pages.

schema.label: Practice Types Served
schema.scrape_hint: Parse services menu, case studies, or 'Who We Serve' sections; match keywords like 'primary care EHR', 'specialty clinic', 'behavioral health EMR', or 'FQHC implementation'.

schema.label: Service Types Offered
schema.scrape_hint: Extract from services pages, homepage offerings, or package descriptions; match phrases like 'EHR go-live', 'data migration', 'HL7/FHIR integration', 'workflow redesign', or 'superuser training'.

schema.label: Typical Engagement Length
schema.scrape_hint: Extract from 'How It Works', FAQ, or project overview pages; look for phrases like 'implementation completed in 90 days', '6-month go-live timeline', or 'ongoing support retainer'.

schema.label: Phone Number
schema.scrape_hint: Extract from header, footer, contact page, or click-to-call buttons; normalize to standard format (e.g., (555) 123-4567).

schema.label: Website
schema.scrape_hint: Capture primary domain from browser address bar, homepage links, or business listings; ensure full URL with https:// protocol.
